تناضحت (form VI)
# تَنَاضَحْتُ (tanāḍaḥtu) /ta.naː.dˤaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# تَنَاضَحْتَ (tanāḍaḥta) /ta.naː.dˤaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# تَنَاضَحْتِ (tanāḍaḥti) /ta.naː.dˤaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاضَحَ (tanāḍaḥa)
# تَنَاضَحَتْ (tanāḍaḥat) /ta.naː.dˤa.ħat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
